storyline.hookSpoilerOn: A clean lap on the Strip can make a weekend; a missed braking point can undo it.

editorialNarrative.formCopy: Norris arrives from a Sao Paulo pole and victory, while Verstappen recovered from 21st to second. That contrast gives qualifying its edge: McLaren's recent one-lap execution meets a Red Bull capable of recovering lost ground.
editorialNarrative.closingCopy: Las Vegas rewarded Mercedes with a Russell-Hamilton one-two in 2024. The 2026 qualifying session precedes a 50-lap Grand Prix on the 6.201-kilometre Strip circuit; pole is an opportunity, not a forecast.

editorialNarrative.hook: Three World Cups, 53 matches and one month begin with the men's defending champions against the Pacific Cup holders.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: The 2026 programme joins men's, women's and wheelchair tournaments rather than treating them as detached events. Australia v New Zealand opens a 31-day path through pool qualification to finals in Wollongong and Brisbane, with current champions supplying the first persistent thread.

editorialNarrative.hook: The first title is a first-versus-first final, but every Twickenham match also counts toward the Hemisphere Crown.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: Separate North and South tables converge across six placement matches from 27–29 November. First against first decides the inaugural Nations Championship, while every pairing contributes to the Hemisphere Crown and the current July tables remain provisional until November resumes.

editorialNarrative.hook: Melbourne's three-week tournament returns with two first-time 2026 champions carrying very different title defences into an unknown draw.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: Opening Week and the 17–31 January main draw create a three-week arc before the singles finals. Alcaraz and Rybakina return as first-time Australian Open champions, while capped early Ground Passes and the record 2026 audience add a real scale consequence without inventing entrants or seeds.

editorialNarrative.hook: Melbourne's 2027 return is certain; the date, ticket release and next Albert Park storyline are not.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: Formula 1 is contracted to return to Melbourne through 2035, but the 2027 date and ticket packages remain unconfirmed. Albert Park's fast temporary-road character supplies durable context while the card remains explicitly TBC instead of turning a planning date into a fixture.

editorialNarrative.hook: General public sales opened at noon AEST on 13 August 2026 through Ticketmaster.
